name: DeskFlex
description_en:
DeskFlex manages shared workplace spaces for hybrid offices: desks, meeting rooms, resources and visitor workflows. Its core inventory is the office space that employees reserve, rather than a customer buying a service appointment.

Booking and attendance are separate states. An employee can reserve a desk without arriving; DeskFlex describes check-in rules that release unused reservations. Evaluation should therefore follow the complete workplace day, including no-shows, resource release and the occupancy view.
description_zh:
DeskFlex 为混合办公管理共享空间，包括工位、会议室、资源和访客流程。其核心库存是员工预留的办公空间，而非客户购买的服务预约。

预订与到场是不同状态：员工可能预留工位却没有来。DeskFlex 介绍通过签到规则释放未使用预约。因此评估应覆盖完整办公日，包括未到场、资源释放及占用视图。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage available workplace spaces across locations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跨地点管理可用办公空间。

core_features.explanation_en: A missed check-in within a configurable window can release a reserved desk or room.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在配置窗口内未签到时，可释放预留的工位或会议室。

en: An employee choosing an office day needs to find an available desk, reserve it, arrive and check in. The facilities team then needs a view that distinguishes reserved space from checked-in occupancy. DeskFlex describes QR codes, Bluetooth beacons and mobile check-in; confirm the selected method and any hardware requirements in the implementation.
zh: 员工选择到岗日期时，需要找到可用工位、预订、到场并签到。设施团队则需要区分已预订空间与已签到占用。DeskFlex 介绍二维码、蓝牙信标及手机签到；实施时应确认所选方式和硬件要求。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Annual subscription by managed workplace spaces; Microsoft calendar/Teams deep integration is an add-on.

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: reserve, arrive and release a desk
sections.title_zh: 示例：预订、到场与释放工位
sections.en:
An employee choosing an office day needs to find an available desk, reserve it, arrive and check in. The facilities team then needs a view that distinguishes reserved space from checked-in occupancy. DeskFlex describes QR codes, Bluetooth beacons and mobile check-in; confirm the selected method and any hardware requirements in the implementation.

Test a reservation with no check-in, one with a timely arrival and one with a late arrival. Inspect whether and when the space becomes bookable again. These are proposed acceptance checks, not a physical occupancy test. Software check-in records alone should not be presented as a verified count of every person in the building.
sections.zh:
员工选择到岗日期时，需要找到可用工位、预订、到场并签到。设施团队则需要区分已预订空间与已签到占用。DeskFlex 介绍二维码、蓝牙信标及手机签到；实施时应确认所选方式和硬件要求。

建议测试未签到、准时到达及迟到三种预约，检查空间是否及何时重新开放。这是验收建议，未经实体占用测试。软件签到记录本身不应当作大楼内所有人员的已核实计数。

sections.title_zh: 空间订阅，实际按年支付
sections.en:
The pricing page says charges depend on workplace spaces rather than employee count. Growth shows $50 per month for up to 25 spaces and one floor plan; Professional $75 for up to 50 spaces and two floor plans. The FAQ explicitly says standard plans are annual subscriptions. These displayed monthly equivalents should not be interpreted as a month-to-month cancellation offer.

Enterprise is custom, covering 100 or more spaces and larger/multi-location implementations. Confirm the gap between published packages, the definition of a space, implementation costs, currency code and taxes. Do not price a mixed desk/room estate simply by counting employee logins.
sections.zh:
定价页表示按办公空间而非员工人数收费。Growth 显示每月 $50，最多 25 个空间及一张楼层图；Professional 为 $75，最多 50 个空间及两张楼层图。FAQ 明确标准套餐按年订阅。因此，显示的月均金额不能理解为按月取消方案。

Enterprise 为定制报价，涵盖 100 个及以上空间和更大规模/多地点实施。应确认公开档位之间的容量需求、空间定义、实施费用、货币代码与税费，不能仅按员工登录账户数为混合工位/会议室计价。

sections.title_en: SSO and calendar integration have different scope
sections.title_zh: SSO 与日历集成范围不同
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ includes Microsoft Entra SSO in every package but puts calendar synchronization and Microsoft Teams status integration in the Microsoft 365 Deep Integration add-on. A Microsoft logo on the homepage is therefore not evidence that all synchronization is covered by the base fee.

List which identities may sign in, which rooms need calendar synchronization, and which status updates must reach Teams. Demonstrate a revoked account and a changed reservation during evaluation. No directory, calendar or permissions test was performed here.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 表示各档均含 Microsoft Entra SSO，但日历同步及 Microsoft Teams 状态集成属于 Microsoft 365 Deep Integration 附加项。因此，首页有 Microsoft 标识，不能证明基础费用包含所有同步。

应列出哪些身份可登录、哪些会议室需要日历同步，以及哪些状态须传到 Teams。评估时建议演示撤销账户和修改预约。本次未执行目录、日历或权限测试。

sections.en:
Facilities staff should prepare a space inventory, floor plans, booking windows, no-show policy, locations and employee access rules. Begin with one representative floor and verify the mobile journey before a larger rollout. A release policy that is too strict can remove a valid reservation; a loose one can leave unused desks unavailable.

The public pages describe a managed workplace platform and mobile access. They do not establish a self-hosted licence, offline operation or disaster-recovery commitments. Visitor registration is part of the platform, but a badge or registration record should not be inferred to be a tested physical-access control system.
sections.zh:
设施团队应准备空间清单、楼层图、预订时间窗口、未到场政策、地点及员工访问规则。先以一个有代表性的楼层验证手机使用流程，再扩大部署。释放规则过严可能移除有效预约，过松则会使闲置工位仍不可订。

公开页面介绍托管办公平台及手机访问，未证明自托管许可、离线能力或灾难恢复承诺。访客登记属于平台，但不能把徽章或登记记录直接认定为已测试的实体门禁系统。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Space-count definitions, intermediate capacity, hardware, add-on price, currency/tax, deployment contract, retention and recovery require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 空间计数定义、中间容量、硬件、附加项价格、货币/税费、部署合同、保留及恢复需确认。

research_gaps.en: No account, physical check-in, calendar synchronization, directory or visitor-access test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、实体签到、日历同步、目录或访客通行。
